verification: Each Pendle entry checked on-chain: YT.PT() == pt, YT.SY() == sy, YT.expiry(), PT/SY decimals(), SY.getTokensIn()/getTokensOut(), SY.yieldToken(). Morpho markets checked with Morpho.idToMarketParams(id). Aave: PoolAddressesProvider.getPool() == pool, Pool.getReserveAToken/getReserveVariableDebtToken(asset), and each token's UNDERLYING_ASSET_ADDRESS(). Keep in sync with contracts/config/MainnetConfig.sol.

USD3.notes: 3Jane senior tranche. Yearn V3 tokenized strategy (apiVersion 3.0.4), ERC-4626 over USDC. Deposits are capped and whitelisted (SY-USD3 is whitelisted); withdrawals limited by availableWithdrawLimit (~4.53M USDC on 2026-10-30).

reUSD.notes: Re Protocol senior tranche. Not ERC-4626; price (NAV) set daily by Re's NAVConsumer, ~1.1103 USDC on 2026-10-29. Minting and redeeming with Re is KYC-gated (and instant redemptions pay sUSDe), so the Executor can't use them: loops buy and sell reUSD against USDC through the aggregators (KyberSwap 2026-10-29: 1M reUSD -> 1.106M USDC, 5M -> 5.527M USDC).

PT-reUSD-10DEC2026/USDC.notes: SY-reUSD only redeems to reUSD: exits sell just enough reUSD for the USDC debt via an aggregator inside the flash loan (the rest comes back as reUSD); entries swap the flash-loaned USDC to reUSD.

PT-USD3-17DEC2026/USDT.notes: USDT debt: exits swap USDC->USDT via an aggregator inside the flash loan (SY-USD3 only redeems to USDC/USD3).

aave.notes: Aave v3 Core market (Pool revision 11). Since 2026 every reserve is frozen with LTV 0 by Aave governance: repay and withdraw work, supply and borrow revert (ReserveFrozen) until it is unfrozen. Borrowing for the owner needs credit delegation (approveDelegation on the variable debt token); withdrawing needs the owner's aToken approval to the Executor.

PT-reUSD-10DEC2026.notes: PT/YT use the SY asset's decimals (USDC, 6); SY wraps reUSD 1:1 (18). SY.exchangeRate() is reUSD's NAV in USDC.

re.notes: Read-only (not on the Executor allowlist): the app reads Re's official instant-redemption fee and status to compare with DEX sales of reUSD. Verified source on Etherscan: redeemInstant checks KYC on msg.sender, pays the active payout token (sUSDe on 2026-10-30) at Re's price router NAV, fee feeBps, max maxRedemption USD per call.

neverAllowlisted.notes: Pendle router and market (AMM) contracts are deliberately excluded from the Executor allowlist.

aggregators.notes: Used only for USDC<->USDT and USDC<->reUSD. Only USDC, USDT and reUSD may be approved to them (Executor recipient allowlist), never Pendle assets. Output enforced by assertMinBalance.
